privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What the site knows about you, why, and for how long.

sections.title: In short
body: This site carries no advertising tracker, no analytics, and passes nothing to anyone for commercial purposes. There is no cookie banner because there is nothing to ask you to accept.
The only data kept is what you enter so the site can weigh your meals rather than somebody else's.

sections.title: What is stored on the server
body: Your account: email address, a name if you give one, a hash of your password — never the password itself —, a Google identifier if you sign in that way, your chosen language, and the dates you signed up and confirmed.

Your profile: sex, age, height, weight, activity outside sport, sessions per week, kind of training, quality of starches, appetite and goal. These answers are used for nothing but working out your nutrition targets.
The weeks you compose: the dishes chosen, never the grammes — those are recomputed from your profile, so they follow your measurements when those change.
Your problem reports: your message, the severity you picked, the page concerned, your browser, your screen size and your language.

sections.title: What never leaves your device
body: The ticked boxes on the shopping list, the dishes marked cooked and the meals marked eaten stay in your browser's storage. They are never sent to the server, and clearing the site's data erases them for good.

sections.title: The shopping extension and Carrefour
body: Filling the Carrefour basket automatically goes through a browser extension you install yourself. It is optional: everything else on the site works without it.

If you use it, the server keeps the list of your paired browsers — a name, a pairing token, the date last seen —, the state of your Carrefour sign-in — signed in or not, and the time it was checked — and the pending fill requests, that is the dishes and quantities to put in the basket.
On your device, the extension only holds the service address and the pairing token, so it knows which account to attach to. No password is stored in it.

Your Carrefour credentials never pass through this site or the extension: you sign in directly on carrefour.fr. The extension acts within your own session, opened by you, only to read whether you are signed in and to fill your basket from your menu. It never confirms or pays for an order: you check and order yourself.
Carrefour is an independent third party: what it does with your data is governed by its own privacy policy. This site is not affiliated with Carrefour.

sections.title: Why this data is processed
body: The account and the profile are needed for the service you asked for: a menu weighed for you. Without them the site shows the recipes as they were written, and nothing is kept.
Reports are kept in order to fix what people ran into, which is the legitimate interest of keeping the site working.

sections.title: For how long
body: Your account, your profile and your weeks are kept as long as the account exists, and erased when it is deleted.
A confirmation link lasts twenty-four hours, a password reset link one hour. After that they are unusable and deleted.
A session lasts thirty days, or until you sign out.
Reports are kept as long as they help fix the problem they describe.

sections.title: Who else can see it
body: Nobody. No data is sold, rented, or passed to third parties for commercial purposes.

Three providers are involved technically: o2switch, in France, which hosts the database and sends the mail; Netlify, in the United States, which serves the pages; and Google, if and only if you choose to sign in with a Google account — Google then passes us your address, your name and your identifier.

Netlify being an American company, serving the pages means a transfer outside the European Union. Those pages hold no personal data: your profile never travels through them, it is asked of the French server directly.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
body: Three cookies, no more. The session one keeps you signed in for thirty days; it is unreadable to JavaScript and travels only over HTTPS. A ten-minute one protects the Google sign-in against request forgery. The last one remembers the language you chose.
All three are strictly necessary or a display preference: the rules exempt them from consent, which is why no banner is put in your way.
Your browser's local storage holds your ticked boxes, as described above.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may ask to see the data concerning you, to correct it, to erase it, to receive a copy of it, or to object to its processing.
Write to the address below: your request will be handled within one month. Deleting an account erases the account, the profile and the saved weeks.
If the answer does not satisfy you, you may refer the matter to the Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés, 3 place de Fontenoy, 75007 Paris.

sections.title: Security
body: Traffic is HTTPS end to end. Passwords are kept as a scrypt hash, never in the clear. The database can only be reached from the server that uses it, never from the internet.
No system is perfectly safe. If you find a flaw, write to us rather than publish it.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: What the site offers, and what it does not promise.

sections.title: Purpose
body: This site offers, free of charge, weekly menus, recipes, a shopping list and quantities worked out for a profile. It is meant for private individuals, for personal use.
Using it means accepting these terms.

sections.title: This is not medical advice
body: The calorie targets and the grammes shown are estimates, worked out from public formulas and the answers you give. They are indications, not a prescription.

This site replaces neither a doctor nor a dietitian. Ask a professional before following these quantities, especially during pregnancy or breastfeeding, with diabetes, kidney, heart or liver disease, while under treatment, with an eating disorder, or for a child or a teenager.
Nutritional values come from composition tables and vary from one product to another. Allergens are not flagged: always read the label.

sections.title: Your account
body: You are responsible for keeping your password to yourself and for what is done from your account. Tell us if you think it has been used without your agreement.
The answers you give should be truthful: an inaccurate profile produces inaccurate quantities.

sections.title: Filling the Carrefour basket
body: Through an extension you install, the site can fill your Carrefour basket from your menu. This feature acts within your own Carrefour account, which you sign in to yourself.
It never confirms or pays for an order. The basket's contents, the quantities, any substituted products and the delivery slot are yours to check and confirm before any payment.
It comes with no guarantee of result: Carrefour may change its site, a product may be missing or replaced by another, an anti-bot check may interrupt it. Always check the basket before ordering.
This site is not affiliated with Carrefour nor endorsed by it. Using Carrefour's site remains subject to Carrefour's own terms, which it is up to you to respect.

sections.title: Availability
body: This site is a personal project, offered with no guarantee of availability or continuity. It may be interrupted, changed or stopped at any time, without notice.
Recipes and menus stay readable offline once the site has been visited; signing in to an account, however, needs a connection.

sections.title: Liability
body: The publisher cannot be held liable for the consequences of using the information published, for a loss of data, or for the service being unavailable.
This limit does not apply to intentional fault or personal injury, as the law provides.

sections.title: Ending use
body: You may stop using the site at any time and ask for your account to be deleted. The publisher may close an account that is being plainly misused.

sections.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute an amicable solution will be sought first; failing that, the French courts have jurisdiction.
